title: Can't open Godot 4.7 in a MacOS 10.15.8 Catalina
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6.x all version are working fine.

### System information

Model: iMac14,1, Quad-Core Intel Core i5, 2.7 GHz, 16 GB, Intel Iris Pro 1536 MB

### Issue description

I downloaded the lastest version of godot(4.7), and when I tried to open and gived the permison to launch, then It get crashed.
